dedupe_keys.name: industrial energy load dataset from a large scale steel plant in tianjin china

description: A North China Electric Power University team publishes an Excel workbook of electricity loads from an iron and steel plant. Zenodo provides the file under CC BY 4.0. The description reports 15-minute readings over 31 days. It distinguishes plant-gate load from process and equipment loads for ironmaking, steelmaking, a furnace, pumps, fans, rolling mills and casting machines. These series can calibrate industrial demand-response and solar-aligned dispatch simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this plant-level release. A limitation is that the text calls the site a Tianjin plant but also places it in Jiangsu Province; the exact location is unresolved. The thirty-one-day window cannot establish annual demand or general industrial flexibility. Claimed on-site screening and adjustment capacity are provider statements, not verified measurements here. The workbook was not downloaded and its timestamps, units and missing values were not checked.
